_comment: Executable form of the qualification rules in the knowledge base. Each rule cites the record it implements; update both together. The agent evaluates these in code so eligibility never depends on LLM judgement.

questions.age: May I ask how old you are?
questions.state: Which state do you live in?
questions.household_size: How many people would need coverage, including you?
questions.tobacco_use: Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
questions.medical_conditions: Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
questions.current_insurance: Do you have any health insurance right now?
questions.callback_time: What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?
questions.consent_to_contact: And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?
